title: fix(service-i18n): a missing translation's fallback is reported once through the plugin logger
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X3vVXCGnUV8qUSmxv8Erd4j)_

Fixes #28109

Clause-②: no (the returned strings are unchanged; a log signal only)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：服务端翻译适配器 `FileI18nAdapter.t()` 在缺翻译回退时，经插件 logger 说一次：请求语言缺某个键、由回退语言补上时，每个「键 + 语言」说一次；请求语言整包都没有时，每个语言只说一次；所有包都没有这个键时记一条 debug。返回给用户的字符串一个字节都不变。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28109（分诊 6524808565）：以前缺翻译时用户看到英文或原始键，运维、作者、CI 谁都不知道。分诊把信号形式交给开发选，并排除新增门禁；本 PR 选「每键一次的运行时警告」。
- **风险与回滚**：只加日志，不改回退顺序和返回值；去重集合上限 1000 条，满了说一句就停，热路径不会刷屏也不会无限占内存。只有应用「提供」的语言（声明的 `supportedLocales`，未声明时即已加载的语言）才是 warn，其余是 debug，所以客户端乱发 `Accept-Language` 推不高 warn 量。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/services/service-i18n/src/file-i18n-adapter.ts`（`t()` 的回退分支与新的 `reportMiss`）；`src/file-i18n-adapter.test.ts` 末尾的新 describe；`src/i18n-service-plugin.ts`（把 `ctx.logger` 传给适配器的一行）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-i18n exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` → 4 个文件 71/71 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The signal: a once-per-key runtime warning** (the dev's choice the triage left open). An author diagnostic was not chosen: most `t()` keys are computed at run time (`objects.X.fields.Y.label`, `validation.field.required`), so no static check can list them, and the triage excludes a new gate.

`FileI18nAdapter` takes an optional `logger` (the `warn` and `debug` members of `Logger` from `@objectstack/spec/contracts`). Without one it is silent, exactly as before, so a library user constructing the adapter by hand sees no change. `I18nServicePlugin.init` passes `ctx.logger`.

On a miss in the requested locale, `t()` calls `reportMiss` after the fallback leg. The fallback order and the returned value are untouched (the reporting reads only what `t()` already computed). Each report is said once:

| Case | Said | Level |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The requested locale lacks the key and the fallback locale serves it | once per key and locale, naming both | `warn` if the stack offers the locale, else `debug` |
| The requested locale has no bundle at all (static or authored) | once per locale, not once per key | `warn` if the stack offers the locale, else `debug` |
| No bundle holds the key; the key itself is returned | once per key and locale | `debug`, always |
| 1000 distinct reports reached | once | `warn`, then silence until restart |

"Offers" is `getLocales()`: the declared `i18n.supportedLocales`, else every loaded locale. For any other locale the client asked for something the app never offered (often straight from `Accept-Language`), the fallback is the designed answer, and a client cannot drive the warn volume by sending locales.

**Why the key-missed-everywhere case is `debug`, not the louder warning the order leaned toward.** At least ten `t()` callers probe on purpose and read the echoed key as "not overridden": the field/object label ladders in objectql (`record-validator.ts`, `engine-validation-messages.ts`, `rule-validator.ts`), the approvals reader labels and refusal override address, the audit activity summary, messaging's notification text, the sandbox hook refusal catalogue and automation's node text. Measured live (below), every both-missed line on a plain boot and page load is one of these probes (`objects.showcase_account.fields.__search.label`, `validation.field.required`, `flows.*.label` in `en`, where the source label lives in metadata, not in a bundle). A `warn` there would report misses nobody has to fix. Messaging already warns once per key for its own catalog misses.

**The bound.** `FileI18nAdapter.MISSING_TRANSLATION_REPORT_LIMIT = 1000`, shared by per-key and per-locale entries. The largest per-page report count measured below is 12 distinct entries per locale, so 1000 leaves room for a whole partial locale while costing at most some tens of KB of short strings.

## Tests

- Red first, on the base implementation with the new tests (`src/file-i18n-adapter.test.ts`, `src/i18n-service-plugin.test.ts`): `Tests 6 failed | 44 passed (50)`. The failures were exactly the reporting cases; the controls ("a hit in the requested locale logs nothing", "returns exactly what an adapter without a logger returns") passed on base.
- Green at head: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-i18n exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` → `Test Files 4 passed (4) · Tests 71 passed (71)`; `pnpm typecheck` exit 0.
- New cases: fallback-served warns once naming locale, key and fallback, and a second call logs nothing; a hit logs nothing; both-missed is one `debug` per key and locale and still returns the key; an offered locale with no bundle is one `warn` for any number of keys; an unoffered locale with no bundle is one `debug`; a fallback in an unoffered locale is `debug` while an offered one is `warn`; an authored translation counts as the locale's bundle and as a hit; the bound stops after 1000 with one closing line; the returned strings (with and without interpolation, every case) equal those of an adapter with no logger; the plugin passes its logger through.
- Ablation (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` of the `this.reportMiss(...)` call in `t()`; tests import `src/` relatively, so no build leg): anchor 1 → 0, blob `bbf3e2c1` → `07a841a0`; `Tests 8 failed | 44 passed (52)` in the two files, every reporting case red and every control green; restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Noise, measured live** on `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` at `OS_LOG_LEVEL=debug`, after a full `pnpm build` and the console build, loading the real Console home (`/_console/home`, 20 to 21 API requests) once per locale in Chromium with that `Accept-Language`. Report lines added by each load:

  | Stack | Boot | en | zh-CN | fr | ja-JP | es-ES |
  | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
  | showcase (offers en, zh-CN) | 1 debug | 8 debug | 2 debug | 1 debug | 12 debug | 12 debug |
  | todo (offers en, zh-CN, ja-JP) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 debug | 0 | not measured |

  Zero `warn` lines on either stack at the head. Base logged nothing of any kind. At the default `info` level a plain boot and page load therefore print nothing new.
- An intermediate head that warned on every locale with a bundle measured 3 `warn` lines per Console home load in ja-JP and in es-ES on the showcase (`objects.showcase_invoice.label`, `objects.showcase_contact.label`, `objects.showcase_account.label`: the platform plugins ship ja-JP/es-ES bundles, the showcase translates its objects only in zh-CN). That is the case the "offered" rule turns into `debug`: the showcase never offered those locales.
- The first measured `fr` load (#28107: `fr` is not a platform locale) gave one line for the whole page, not one per key.
- A locale requested before its bundles are pushed (platform bundles load at `kernel:ready`) would be reported as having no bundle once; none of the measured boots produced such a line.
